feature: Report 'Unclaimed Batch Data' 15 kolom dari hasil enquiry MHA/DataHive (alamat per ID), plus penghapusan ocms_adhoc_nro_temp setelah report
story: OCMS20.8, OCMS20.9 (mirip; kemungkinan milik OCMS20.20/20.27 di chunk lain)
note: checkAndGenerateBatchDataReport membuat report alamat hasil enquiry dan menghapus baris adhoc, tetapi tidak punya pemanggil di ocmsadminapi maupun ocmsadminprivateapi (grep); cron harian memanggil executeJob yang hanya membuat daftar TS-UNC 11 kolom (DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:100). SQL memfilter query_reason='UNC' padahal entity OcmsTempUncHstAddr tidak punya kolom itu; kolom di DB cannot verify from repo. Dicatat sebagai code yang ada tetapi tidak terjangkau.
note_en: checkAndGenerateBatchDataReport builds the enquiry address report and deletes the adhoc rows, but has no caller in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep); the daily cron calls executeJob, which only builds the 11-column TS-UNC list (DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:100). The SQL filters on query_reason='UNC' while the entity OcmsTempUncHstAddr has no such column; the DB column cannot be verified from repo. Logged as code that exists but is unreachable.

feature: Penyimpanan shareholder/board ACRA per UEN ke ocms_dh_acra_shareholder_info/board_info dan tab Director/Shareholder di Vault staff portal
note: Shareholder disimpan dan board query berjalan tetapi penulisan board dimatikan (komentar OCMS-DEV-2026-231). Dipakai untuk tampilan data company di notice, bukan untuk mengalihkan reminder. Kemungkinan milik story DataHive/UEN di epic lain.
note_en: Shareholders are saved and the board query runs, but the board write is switched off (comment OCMS-DEV-2026-231). Used to display company data on the notice, not to redirect reminders. Probably belongs to a DataHive/UEN story in another epic.
